title: Catering and Facilities Management Services Framework
raw_text: St. Adalbert Regional Health Trust is retendering catering, vending, and soft facilities management across four hospital sites, totalling roughly 1.1 million meals per month. The framework runs for five years with two break points. Current performance on patient satisfaction is poor and the trust expects measurable improvement. Suppliers must evidence allergen management to current standards, and must meet the trust's ethical sourcing policy. Two sites are operating under an interim arrangement that ends in eleven weeks, so a transition plan is required. Pricing must be transparent and separable by site and by service line. The trust is not seeking a proprietary system as part of this contract.
requirements: Five-year framework with two break points
Allergen management evidence to current standards
Transition plan for two sites on an interim arrangement ending in eleven weeks
Transparent pricing separable by site and service line
